figurative_meaning_bn: তাপমাত্রা বেড়ে যাওয়া; উত্তেজনা বৃদ্ধি পাওয়া
figurative_meaning_en: temperature rising; increase in excitement or tension
example_sentences_in_english: The mercury is rising in the meeting.
The mercury shot up in the midst of the debate.
note: Idiom draws from the imagery of a thermometer, reflecting modern scientific influence in Bengali expression.
